brand.name: Wellness with Anisha

hero.eyebrow: Osteopathy · Physiotherapy · Yoga · Art of Living
hero.body: As an Osteopathy Practitioner, Physiotherapy Specialist, and Certified Yoga and Art of Living Instructor, Dr. Anisha bridges traditional healing therapies with modern science to restore balance and vitality to your life.

services.title: The work
services.note: Different bodies need different conversations. Start where you are.

items.name: Osteopathy
items.detail: Hands-on structural treatment that finds the cause of pain rather than chasing the symptom, so the body can hold its own alignment again.

items.name: Physiotherapy
items.detail: Targeted rehabilitation and movement work to rebuild strength, restore mobility, and keep an old injury from becoming a permanent habit.

items.name: Yoga and Meditation
items.detail: Authentic yoga and guided meditation, taught by a certified instructor and shaped around your body rather than a class plan.

items.name: Art of Living Programs
items.detail: Mindfulness and breath programs from the Art of Living tradition, including the Happiness Program, for stress relief and lasting inner calm.

story.title: Journey to wellness with Anisha.
paragraphs: Welcome to your holistic guide to a healthier, happier, and more balanced life. Here you will discover the transformative power of osteopathy, physiotherapy, Art of Living programs, and yoga sessions, all designed to nurture your mind, body, and soul.
Whether you seek pain relief, enhanced mobility, stress reduction, or overall mind-body harmony, the approach here focuses on natural, sustainable healing.
story.highlightCredential: Certified Yoga & Art of Living Instructor

pricing.title: What it costs
pricing.note: Payment is taken at the studio after your session. Nothing is charged when you book, and a bundle is only a reservation until Dr. Anisha activates it.

singleSession.title: Single session
singleSession.detail: Pay as you go. No commitment beyond the hour you book.
includes: Full assessment on the first visit

visit.title: The studio
visit.gettingHere: Nearest station is a short auto ride away. Street parking is easiest before 11am.

footer.blurb: Your holistic guide to a healthier, happier, and more balanced life, through osteopathy, physiotherapy, Art of Living programs, and yoga.
